mechanism_claims.claim_text: PhciCath5 directly permeabilizes E. coli ATCC25922 membranes in a CellTox Green assay, reaching the source-reported permeability threshold within 1 hour at 4x MIC and later at MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports bacterial membrane permeabilization for E. coli; it does not prove the same physical mechanism in C. pecorum elementary bodies.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PhciCath5 anti-chlamydial activity is supported by extracellular elementary-body inactivation before host-cell infection, with reduced infectious progeny for both C. pecorum serovars.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PhciCath5 against Chlamydia pecorum MarsBar and IPTaLE elementary bodies
